strings.header:
// RML typed runtime graph

/*
 * Generated by the RML Configuration Builder.
 *
 * STEP 1 - Configuration values
 * The main mod source forwards the current RML configuration values into
 * this generated runtime class through the Set... methods below.
 *
 * STEP 2 - Runtime reactions
 * React... methods are entry points for Configuration sockets configured to
 * react when settings are saved. Startup-capable sockets are emitted from
 * OnEngineInit(). Stored-only sockets remain typed value sources.
 *
 * STEP 3 - Typed graph execution
 * Emit... methods are the generated impulse paths. Value inputs are resolved
 * from their connected typed sources when an impulse path executes.
 *
 * STEP 4 - Runtime state and outputs
 * Generated fields retain node state and action outputs. Display Value and
 * Display Impulse nodes publish through DisplayValues/DisplayValueChanged and
 * stream to the local scanner runtime bridge when that scanner is installed.
 *
 * This file is generated from the visual graph. Edit the graph rather than
 * editing this generated file manually.
 */
strings.disposedWorldQueue: // A disposed/transitioning world cannot retain a runnable queue.
strings.fifoBarrier:
// Every queued graph delegate has now crossed a FIFO barrier. Wait
        // once more for an entry that began immediately before its barrier.
strings.faultedTaskDrain:
// A finished faulted task is still fully drained. Its graph
                // error was already reported at the execution boundary.
strings.worldMutationContext:
// Updates is only a wait primitive. World.RunSynchronously
                    // is what grants the valid world mutation context.
strings.loggingBoundary: // Logging must never escape back into Resonite's host callback.
strings.noDisplaySources: // No runtime display or editable collection sources are present.
strings.monitorWorldTransition: // A temporary world transition must not stop the monitor pump.
strings.patchRegistration: // Generated registration marker for the matching custom RML loader.
strings.advancedSource: Advanced C# nodes remove the expressiveness ceiling, but their source is intentionally exported verbatim and must be compiled against the target Resonite/RML assemblies.
